Category / Award: Category 1: Award of JRF & Appointment as Assistant Professor
Conducting Body: National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of UGC
Minimum Educational Qualification: Master’s Degree or equivalent with at least 55% marks (50% for OBC-NCL, SC, ST, PwD, Third Gender)
Age Criterion: Not more than 30 Years as on 1st day of the month (Up to 5 years relaxation for OBC/SC/ST/PwD/Women/LLM)
Scope & Privilege: Eligible for prestigious UGC Junior Research Fellowship financial grant + Direct eligibility for Assistant Professor in Universities/Colleges nationwide
Qualifying Standard: Top ~1% to 2% candidates qualifying in both Paper 1 and Paper 2 as per official NTA percentile cutoffs

Category / Award: Category 2: Appointment as Assistant Professor & Admission to Ph.D.
Conducting Body: National Testing Agency (NTA) on behalf of UGC
Minimum Educational Qualification: Master’s Degree or equivalent with at least 55% marks (50% for reserved categories)
Age Criterion: No Upper Age Limit for Assistant Professor eligibility
Scope & Privilege: Direct lifelong eligibility for Assistant Professor recruitment across all Indian Universities and admission to Ph.D. without separate entrance test
Qualifying Standard: Top 6% of appearing candidates who appear in both papers and secure aggregate qualifying marks (40% General / 35% Reserved)
